name: an-extension-side-panel-card-follows-the-page-in-fullscreen
description: With the extension side panel open, real content fullscreen (the page's own requestFullscreen button, the path video-fullscreen-sidebar uses) makes the panel card edge to edge: no gap at the window edge, no rounded corner, no shadow. Leaving fullscreen brings the gap and the rounded corner back. Light and dark captures are the theme evidence.

actions.note: gate: the page with the fullscreen button committed
the window opens wider than the screen, and leaving fullscreen restores that frame at a width that differs per run, so the exit checks need a real frame that fits
the VM keeps the last run's appearance

actions.expression: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.exs-chip[data-extension-id="ockdpgepnciealdnaddnkfcnbieickai"]'); if (!c) { return 'no-chip'; } const b = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2) + ',' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2 + 30); })()
actions.note: the chip's centre on screen, 30px below its client y
